payload.name: beglaubigt.de
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Beglaubigt sets up a German company — a GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) — directly in the conversation. Tell the assistant you want to incorporate and it collects the details one step at a time: company name and purpose, share capital, the shareholder(s) and managing director, and how you'd like to notarize. When everything's ready it returns a secure checkout link you open in your browser — the assistant never processes payment itself.

On the back end, Beglaubigt coordinates the notarization, the commercial-register (Handelsregister) filing, and your formation documents, so you can start a German company without assembling the paperwork yourself. It's built for founders in Germany and for international entrepreneurs incorporating there.

Currently supports GmbH and UG formation. After the checkout link, you complete payment and your notary appointment through Beglaubigt.
payload.longDescription:
Beglaubigt 直接在对话中帮助成立德国公司——GmbH 或 UG（haftungsbeschränkt，有限责任）。告诉助手你想注册公司，它会逐步收集详细信息：公司名称和经营目的、股本、股东和总经理，以及你希望采用的公证方式。一切准备好后，它会返回一个安全结账链接，由你在浏览器中打开——助手从不自行处理付款。

在后台，Beglaubigt 协调公证、商业登记册（Handelsregister）申报及公司设立文件，让你无需自行整理文书即可成立德国公司。它适用于德国境内的创始人，以及在德国注册公司的国际创业者。

目前支持 GmbH 和 UG 的设立。获得结账链接后，你需通过 Beglaubigt 完成付款和公证预约。

payload.name: Chiho AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chiho AI connects ChatGPT to a user's Telegram account so they can search and read conversations, organize CRM tags, companies, tasks, summaries, and automation rules, safely preview and approve messages and group actions, and manage Telegram folders.
payload.longDescription: Chiho AI将ChatGPT与用户的Telegram账户连接，以便用户能够搜索和阅读对话、整理客户关系管理标签/公司/任务/摘要和自动化规则、安全预览并批准消息及群组操作、管理Telegram文件夹。

payload.name: ChristianaCare Careers
payload.description: 查找 ChristianaCare 的工作机会
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ChristianaCare Careers helps you discover job opportunities at ChristianaCare in one place.

Instead of browsing multiple pages, you can search for roles by job title, specialty, or location and quickly explore available opportunities across the organization. The app makes it easy to understand what each role involves and identify positions that match your experience and interests.

The app is designed to simplify career exploration within ChristianaCare. Whether you’re actively applying or just learning about opportunities, it helps you navigate openings without unnecessary complexity.

When you find a role that interests you, you can review the details and proceed to the official application process.

Key features
• Search jobs by title, specialty, or location
• Explore opportunities across ChristianaCare
• View role details and requirements in one place
• Access official application pages for each role
payload.longDescription:
ChristianaCare Careers 帮助你在一个地方发现 ChristianaCare 的工作机会。

无需浏览多个页面，你可以按职位名称、专科或地点搜索，快速浏览整个机构的职位空缺。该应用让你轻松了解每个职位的工作内容，并找出符合自身经验和兴趣的岗位。

该应用旨在简化你在 ChristianaCare 内的职业探索。无论你正在积极申请，还是只想了解有哪些机会，它都能帮助你轻松浏览职位空缺。

找到感兴趣的职位后，你可以查看详情并进入官方申请流程。

主要功能
• 按职位名称、专科或地点搜索工作
• 浏览 ChristianaCare 各处的工作机会
• 在一处查看职位详情和要求
• 访问各职位的官方申请页面

payload.name: Mindola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mindola helps you turn approved information about yourself, your work, or your business into a shareable Q&A page. Create a reviewable AI lens that can answer questions, explain what you do, guide visitors to the right next step, and preserve useful context. You stay in control of what is included, and nothing is created until you approve it.
payload.longDescription: Mindola 可将关于你本人、工作或企业的经批准信息，转化为可分享的问答页面。创建一个可审核的 AI 视角，用于回答问题、解释你的业务、引导访客采取下一步行动并保留有用背景。哪些内容被纳入由你掌控，未经你批准不会创建任何内容。

payload.name: Sellerise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sellerise brings your Amazon business data into ChatGPT - clear, structured, and ready to analyze.

Connect your Sellerise account to ask questions about sales, profit, advertising, inventory, keyword rankings, Amazon Search Query Performance, reviews, reimbursements, payouts, Subscribe & Save, and overall account performance.

Get fast answers without digging through dashboards: compare periods, spot profit leaks, find inefficient ad spend, identify stock risks, and see which products, campaigns, keywords, or search terms need attention.

Use it to understand what changed, what is driving performance, and where your Amazon business may be losing money or missing opportunities.

Sellerise uses read-only access to your Amazon business data, so you can analyze performance and make better-informed decisions without modifying your account. Sellerise is Amazon ToS-compliant, helping you analyze and understand your business while staying aligned with Amazon’s rules.
payload.longDescription:
Sellerise 将你的 Amazon 业务数据带入 ChatGPT，信息清晰、结构化，可直接用于分析。

连接 Sellerise 账户后，你可以询问销售额、利润、广告、库存、关键词排名、Amazon Search Query Performance、评价、补偿款、付款、Subscribe & Save 以及账户整体表现。

无需翻找仪表板即可快速获取答案：比较不同时期、发现利润流失、找出低效广告支出、识别库存风险，并查看哪些商品、广告活动、关键词或搜索词需要关注。

借助它了解发生了哪些变化、哪些因素影响了表现，以及你的 Amazon 业务可能在哪些方面亏损或错失机会。

Sellerise 以只读方式访问你的 Amazon 业务数据，让你分析表现并作出更有依据的决策，同时不会修改账户。Sellerise 符合 Amazon ToS，帮助你在遵循 Amazon 规则的同时分析和了解业务。

payload.name: Data247
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and ChatGPT runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. Before you call or text a US number, check it against the Do-Not-Call registry, and add numbers to your internal DNC list when someone opts out. Looking into a suspicious signup or order? Geolocate the IP for proxy/VPN signals and screen the details for fraud.

Upload spreadsheets or lists of data to be cleaned, appended to, or  validated, and ChatGPT will consult Data247 and give it back to you completely processed.

It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

You must have an active Data247 account, and lookups are billed per use against your prepaid balance — checking your balance and rate card is free, and you can ask for either anytime.
payload.longDescription:
Data247 将实时联系信息和身份数据带入 ChatGPT，可用于识别和验证联系信息、欺诈活动、TCPA 合规性等。

用自然语言提出请求，ChatGPT 就会为你执行查询：确认电话号码是否有效及其运营商和线路类型，检查电子邮件是否可送达，验证邮政地址，或根据电话号码或邮箱查找相关人员。在拨打或发送短信到美国号码前，可查询其是否在谢绝来电登记册中，并在有人选择退出后将号码加入内部 DNC 名单。若要调查可疑注册或订单，可定位 IP 地址以检查代理/VPN 信号，并筛查相关信息是否存在欺诈风险。

上传需要清理、补充或验证的数据电子表格或列表，ChatGPT 会向 Data247 查询并将完全处理后的结果交还给你。

它适用于保持 CRM 数据整洁、在外联前验证并丰富潜在客户信息、遵守电话营销规则，以及审核被标记的账户。

你必须拥有有效的 Data247 账户；每次查询都会从预付余额中扣费。查询余额和费率表免费，你可以随时提出请求。

payload.name: Meticulate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meticulate helps B2B teams discover target accounts, find prospects, review and approve outbound proposals, inspect prospecting activity, and tune targeting and messaging workflows from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Meticulate 帮助 B2B 团队发掘目标客户和潜在客户、审核并批准外联提案、检查客户开发活动，并通过 ChatGPT 调整目标定位和消息工作流。

payload.name: SignalSumo
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中查看你的 SEO 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SignalSumo connects your SEO account to ChatGPT. Ask about your tracked keyword positions and how they've moved, pull real Search Console queries, check a domain's backlink profile, see how often your brand appears in AI assistant answers, and start a technical site audit. Every answer comes from your own SignalSumo account under the same plan limits and quotas as the web app. Requires a SignalSumo account on a Pro or Agency plan.
payload.longDescription: SignalSumo 将你的 SEO 账户连接到 ChatGPT。询问已跟踪关键词的排名及其变化，获取真实的 Search Console 查询，检查域名的反向链接概况，查看品牌在 AI 助手回答中出现的频率，并启动技术网站审计。所有回答均来自你的 SignalSumo 账户，并遵循与网页版应用相同的方案限制和配额。需要拥有 Pro 或 Agency 方案的 SignalSumo 账户。

payload.name: Rhythm Systems
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rhythm Systems is a strategy operating system for mid-market business leaders. This AI Connector gives your AI assistant secure, per-user access to your company's Rhythm data: strategic and annual plans, quarterly goals and KPIs, meeting agendas, tasks, Week in Sync notes, job scorecards, and dashboards. Ask about goal status, update priorities, prepare for meetings, and capture notes — all governed by your existing Rhythm permissions via OAuth. Requires a Rhythm Systems account with AI Connector access enabled by your administrator.
payload.longDescription: Rhythm Systems 是面向中型市场业务领导者的战略运营系统。此 AI Connector 为 AI 助手提供按用户隔离的安全访问，读取公司的 Rhythm 数据：战略和年度计划、季度目标与 KPI、会议议程、任务、Week in Sync 笔记、职位记分卡和仪表板。您可以询问目标状态、更新优先级、准备会议和记录笔记；所有操作均通过 OAuth 受现有 Rhythm 权限管理。需要 Rhythm Systems 账户，并由管理员启用 AI Connector 访问权限。

payload.name: Pingpong
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pingpong runs your question through multiple AI models in sequence. Each model challenges and refines the work before one final answer is returned, with sources when current evidence matters. Use it to pressure-test decisions, plans, drafts, and claims that should not rely on one model alone.
payload.longDescription: Pingpong 会依次让多个 AI 模型处理您的问题。每个模型都会对工作成果提出质疑并加以完善，之后再返回最终答案；在需要最新证据时，还会附上来源。可用于对决策、计划、草稿和论断进行压力测试，避免只依赖单个模型。

payload.name: Asbie
payload.description: 你的 AI 商务伙伴
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Asbie is an AI-powered CRM companion that brings your customer and business data directly into ChatGPT.

Use natural language to search contacts, companies, deals, tasks, and notes from your Asbie workspace. Stay on top of customer relationships, track sales opportunities, and manage daily activities without switching between multiple applications.

Designed for freelancers, consultants, sales professionals, educators, small businesses, and growing teams who want a simpler and more efficient way to manage customer relationships.
payload.longDescription:
Asbie 是 AI 驱动的 CRM 助手，将客户和业务数据直接带入 ChatGPT。

使用自然语言搜索 Asbie 工作区中的联系人、公司、交易、任务和笔记。掌握客户关系、追踪销售机会、管理日常活动，无需在多个应用之间切换。

专为希望以更简单、更高效的方式管理客户关系的自由职业者、顾问、销售专业人士、教育工作者、小型企业和成长中的团队设计。

payload.name: WareMatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WareMatch is the first 3PL warehousing marketplace. We connect businesses with 3pl providers tailored to their needs. 3PL operators get matched with brands that align with their capabilities, while brands receive bids from 3PLs who specialize in their particular needs. It's a direct, transparent way for both Brands and 3PLs to find the right fit and secure better logistics solutions.
payload.longDescription: WareMatch 是首个 3PL 仓储市场平台。我们为企业对接符合其需求的第三方物流（3PL）服务商。3PL 运营商会与能力相符的品牌进行匹配；品牌则会收到专门满足其特定需求的 3PL 报价。这为品牌和 3PL 双方提供了一种直接、透明的方式，以找到合适伙伴并获得更好的物流解决方案。

payload.name: inSitu Sales
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: inSitu Sales helps manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors find customers and products; review pricing, inventory, visits, orders, estimates, and invoices; generate customer statements; predict order recommendations; and create or update sales records through ChatGPT. It connects with ERP and accounting systems—including QuickBooks Enterprise, QuickBooks Online, Odoo, NetSuite, SAP Business One, Xero, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and more—bringing sales and operational data together in one connected workflow.
payload.longDescription: inSitu Sales 帮助制造商、批发商和分销商查找客户和产品，查看价格、库存、拜访、订单、报价和发票，生成客户对账单，预测订货建议，并通过 ChatGPT 创建或更新销售记录。它连接 QuickBooks Enterprise/Online、Odoo、NetSuite、SAP Business One、Xero、Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 等 ERP 与会计系统。

payload.name: Johns Hopkins Careers
payload.description: 查找 Johns Hopkins 的职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Johns Hopkins makes it easy to find the right job seamlessly in ChatGPT. 

You can search open roles by title or keywords, then refine results by location and salary to help decide which opportunities fit you best.

Try asking things like:
- Find nurse jobs in Baltimore over $90k
- Show me medical assistant jobs

When you’re ready, click ‘View & Apply’ on ChatGPT, and you’ll go straight to the Johns Hopkins Careers site to complete the application.
payload.longDescription:
Johns Hopkins 让你可以在 ChatGPT 中轻松找到合适的工作。

你可以按职位名称或关键词搜索开放职位，再按地点和薪资细化结果，判断哪些机会最适合你。

可以尝试这样提问：
- 查找巴尔的摩薪资超过 $90k 的护士职位
- 显示医疗助理职位

准备好后，点击 ChatGPT 上的“View & Apply”，即可直接前往 Johns Hopkins Careers 网站完成申请。

payload.name: Pixelesq
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Pixelesq website to ChatGPT and manage it through conversation. Create landing pages by choosing from over 60 section types, generate content, and save pages ready to publish. Manage blog posts, team bios, case studies, and other structured content. Monitor Google Search Console rankings, indexing status, and site traffic. Update SEO metadata, create URL redirects, and customize your site's theme without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 将 Pixelesq 网站连接到 ChatGPT，通过对话进行管理。从 60 多种版块类型中选择来创建着陆页、生成内容，并保存可供发布的页面。管理博客文章、团队简介、案例研究和其他结构化内容。监控 Google Search Console 排名、索引状态和网站流量。更新 SEO 元数据、创建 URL 重定向，并在 ChatGPT 中自定义网站主题。

payload.name: Itcons.app Work Reports
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Itcons.app helps teams manage work reports.  This ChatGPT app lets authorized Itcons.app users securely connect their own Itcons.app account and query operational data from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Itcons.app 可帮助团队管理工作报告。此 ChatGPT 应用允许获授权的 Itcons.app 用户安全连接自己的 Itcons.app 账户，并在 ChatGPT 中查询运营数据。

payload.name: Checkin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask ChatGPT about the events your Checkin account can access—without exporting reports. Find events, attendees, contacts, and orders; monitor ticket sales and check-ins; review payment status and revenue; and compare event performance. All tools are read-only and respect your existing Checkin account permissions.
payload.longDescription: 询问 ChatGPT 关于 Checkin 账户可访问的活动，无需导出报告。查找活动、参与者、联系人和订单；监控售票和签到；查看付款状态和收入；并比较活动表现。所有工具均为只读，并遵循您现有的 Checkin 账户权限。

payload.name: Influencer Hero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Influencer Hero is an influencer marketing platform for consumer brands. This connector lets you run your influencer program in conversation instead of clicking through the dashboard.

Discovery. Search a database of creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube by audience demographics, engagement, and location. Pull full audience reports and verified contact details.

Outreach. List and inspect campaigns, add creators to them, and review the email flows and scheduled sends attached to each one.

CRM. Query your deal pipeline by campaign, board, funnel stage, country, or follower count. Open a deal for its history, notes, tasks, and scheduled communications. Create deals, move them between funnel stages, and log notes and tasks.

Collaborations and performance. Break down a collaboration's orders, revenue, top products, and performance over time. Pull campaign reports across date ranges, and review payouts and payout analytics.

Content. Search captured UGC across creators, campaigns, brands, and products, and manage creator submissions through review and approval.

Access follows the signed-in user. The connector inherits that user's role and brand permissions exactly as the web app does, so it can never read or change anything the user could not reach directly. Discovery, audience reports, and contact lookups consume account credits and say so before running.
payload.longDescription:
Influencer Hero 是面向消费品牌的网红营销平台，让您通过对话运行网红项目。

可按受众人口统计、互动率和位置搜索
Instagram、TikTok、YouTube
创

、看板、漏斗阶段、国家或粉丝数查询
CRM 交易，创建交易、移动阶段、记录备注和任务；分

析合作订单、收入、热门产品和表现，查看活动报告及付款和付款分析；搜索并管理创作者
UGC

的审核和批准。访问权限严格遵循登录用户的角色和品牌权限，与网页应用完全一致，因此无法读

取或更改用户无权直接访问的内容。发现、受众报告和联系人查询会消耗账户额度，运行前会提示。

payload.name: New York LLC Publication
payload.description: 纽约 LLC 成本与报纸查询
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Just formed an LLC in New York? Find out the publication requirement, how much it costs to publish by county, and which newspapers you need — before the 120-day deadline. Live pricing for all 62 NY counties. Works for domestic LLCs, foreign LLCs, and PLLCs.

What you can do:
- Check if your LLC needs to publish and what happens if you don't
- Get county-specific pricing and designated newspaper lists
- Generate a legally compliant publication notice
- Verify an existing notice for compliance issues
- Review your filing package before mailing to the state
- Get step-by-step guidance for the full process

 Data sourced from NY LLC Law §206, county clerk offices, and llcpublishers.com — updated regularly.
payload.longDescription:
刚在纽约成立 LLC？在 120 天截止期限前，了解出版要求、各县的刊登费用，以及需要在哪些报纸上刊登。覆盖纽约州全部 62 个县的实时价格。适用于本州 LLC、外州 LLC 和 PLLC。

你可以：
- 检查你的 LLC 是否需要刊登公告，以及不刊登会有什么后果
- 获取按县区划分的价格和指定报纸名单
- 生成符合法律要求的公告
- 检查现有公告是否存在合规问题
- 邮寄给州政府前审查提交材料
- 获取整个流程的分步指导

数据来源于 NY LLC Law §206、县书记官办公室和 llcpublishers.com，并会定期更新。

payload.name: Translations Universe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get live price and delivery estimates for professional human translation, certified and sworn translation, MTPE, revision, and website or CMS localization. Choose the languages, volume, subject area and urgency to receive an estimated price in EUR and delivery time. This plugin provides quotations only and does not create orders or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 获取专业人工翻译、认证及宣誓翻译、MTPE、校对，以及网站或 CMS 本地化的实时价格和交付时间估算。选择语言、文本量、主题领域和紧急程度，即可获得以 EUR 计价的估算价格和交付时间。此插件仅提供报价，不会创建订单或处理付款。

payload.name: Pattern Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pattern Intelligence is an AI agent for ecommerce brand management. Ask questions about your business performance, buy box health, price suppression, inventory gaps, and marketplace trends across Amazon, Walmart, and beyond — and get instant, expert-backed answers. Built on Pattern's 13 years of marketplace expertise and 77+T proprietary data points, Pattern Intelligence monitors your brand around the clock, surfaces risks before they hit your P&L, and resolves them automatically. No more waiting on reports or chasing down answers. Pattern Intelligence gives you the intelligence to lead your business, not just report on it — so ecommerce leaders and brand managers can operate at scale with confidence.
payload.longDescription: Pattern Intelligence 是用于电商品牌管理的 AI 代理。询问有关业务表现、购物车首选位健康度、价格抑制、库存缺口和 Amazon、Walmart 等平台市场趋势的问题，即可获得即时的专家支持答案。它建立在 Pattern 13 年市场经验和超过 77 万亿个专有数据点之上，全天候监控品牌，在风险影响损益表前发现风险并自动解决。无需等待报告或追问答案。Pattern Intelligence 提供帮助你领导业务的情报，而不只是报告数据，让电商领导者和品牌经理能够自信地规模化运营。

payload.name: IQRush
payload.description: 衡量 AI 搜索可见度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IQRush helps teams inspect AI-search visibility, citations, brand mentions, sentiment, grounding sources, trend changes, page performance, and connected GA4 and Search Console analytics.
payload.longDescription: IQRush 帮助团队检查 AI 搜索中的可见度、引用、品牌提及、情绪、依据来源、趋势变化、网页表现，以及关联的 GA4 和 Search Console 分析数据。

payload.name: Brokly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Brokly answers the commercial-insurance questions small-business owners actually have — in plain English, right inside ChatGPT.

Tell Brokly your trade and state, and it pulls from state filings, statutes, and other official sources to lay out exactly what coverage you're required to carry.

Already have coverage or a few quotes? The Brokly Coverage Analysis Tool checks the limits you carry against what your state requires — or against the insurance section of a contract you've been handed — and tells you exactly where you clear the bar and where you fall short.

Try asking things like:
"What insurance does an electrician in Texas need?"
"What does workers' comp cost for a 3-person plumbing shop in Florida?"
"What's the difference between general liability and professional liability?"

With Brokly, figuring out business insurance is a conversation instead of a research project. No jargon, no sales pitch — just clear answers grounded in official sources, so you know where you stand before you buy, renew, or sign.

告诉 Brokly 您的行业和州，它会从州备案、法规及其他官方来源中整理出您依法必须购买的具体保障。

“德州电工需要哪些保险？”

“一般责任险和职业责任险有什么区别？”

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Valuecase MCP connects ChatGPT to your Valuecase workspace, letting you create, manage, and monitor digital sales rooms and onboarding spaces directly from the conversation. payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Specter is a B2B intelligence platform that helps investment professionals research companies, investors, and people for due diligence, deal sourcing, portfolio monitoring, competitive analysis, and relationship mapping. Through ChatGPT you can resolve a company or person from a name, domain, email, or LinkedIn URL, run natural-language discovery searches across companies, investors, funding rounds, acquisitions, and IPOs, and pull deep profiles with funding history, valuations, revenue estimates, competitive landscapes, and talent or investor-interest signals. You can save searches, curate private lists, and fetch professional or personal contact emails for the people you are researching. All results come from Specter's curated dataset, your saved searches, and your own lists.
payload.longDescription: Specter 是一个 B2B 情报平台，帮助投资专业人士研究公司、投资者和个人，用于尽职调查、交易发掘、投资组合监测、竞争分析和关系映射。通过 ChatGPT，你可以使用名称、域名、电子邮件或 LinkedIn URL 确认公司或个人身份；通过自然语言搜索公司、投资者、融资轮次、收购和 IPO；还可以获取包含融资历史、估值、收入估算、竞争格局以及人才或投资者兴趣信号的深度资料。你可以保存搜索、整理私人名单，并获取所研究对象的工作或个人联系邮箱。所有结果均来自 Specter 精选数据集、你保存的搜索和你自己的名单。

payload.name: lemlist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
lemlist is a sales engagement platform for running multichannel outreach across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp, and SMS from a single sequence.

Campaigns and sequences: create campaigns, draft and preview personalized multichannel sequences step by step, set up A/B variants and AI-generated variables, validate a campaign before launch, and start, pause, or resume it.

Leads and prospecting: search your existing campaign leads, add or import leads, update their data and custom variables, and search the lemlist leads database to build new lists. Enrichment tools can look up a lead's professional email and phone number, individually or in bulk, using enrichment credits from your plan.

Signals and watch lists: build watch lists that track buying signals on companies you care about, browse the signal library, and turn a watch list into a campaign.

CRM and contacts: create and update contacts and companies, organize them into lists, import them from CSV, and push campaign leads into your contact database.

Conversations and activity: read your unified inbox, follow up on conversations, reply to a lead, review call activity and outcomes, and work through your task list.

Deliverability and sending infrastructure: check the deliverability and DNS health of your sending domains, review and configure DNS records, run a deliverability audit and inbox placement tests, and connect, test, and manage the mailboxes you send from.

Reporting: track how campaigns perform with detailed stats and reports across channels.

Account: review your team, users, sending settings, unsubscribe list, and webhooks.

All actions run on your own lemlist workspace with your own data, using the permissions granted to the connected account.
payload.longDescription:
lemlist 是一款销售互动平台，可通过单一序列开展电子邮件、LinkedIn、电话、WhatsApp 和 SMS 多渠道外联。

营销活动与序列：创建营销活动，逐步起草并预览个性化多渠道序列，设置 A/B 版本和 AI 生成变量，在启动前验证营销活动，并启动、暂停或恢复。

潜在客户与拓客：搜索现有营销活动中的潜在客户、添加或导入潜在客户、更新其数据和自定义变量，并搜索 lemlist 潜在客户数据库以创建新名单。增强工具可单独或批量查询潜在客户的工作邮箱和电话号码，使用你套餐中的数据增强额度。

信号与关注列表：建立关注列表，跟踪你关心公司的购买信号；浏览信号库，并将关注列表转化为营销活动。

CRM 与联系人：创建和更新联系人及公司，将其整理到列表中，从 CSV 导入，并将营销活动的潜在客户推送到联系人数据库。

对话与活动：阅读统一收件箱、跟进对话、回复潜在客户、查看通话活动和结果，并处理任务列表。

送达率与发送基础设施：检查发送域名的送达率和 DNS 状况，查看并配置 DNS 记录，运行送达率审计和收件箱投放测试，并连接、测试和管理用于发送邮件的邮箱。

报告：通过跨渠道的详细统计数据和报告跟踪营销活动表现。

账户：查看团队、用户、发送设置、退订名单和 webhooks。

所有操作都在你自己的 lemlist 工作区中运行，使用你自己的数据，并遵循已连接账户授予的权限。

payload.name: Meteomatics Weather
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A connector that plugs Meteomatics' weather data directly. Ask natural language questions about real-time and forecast weather, and get instant structured data back, no manual API calls needed.

Used by: Energy traders, logistics companies, renewable operators, insurance teams, and aviation planners who need weather-intelligent AI workflows.
payload.longDescription:
直接接入 Meteomatics 天气数据。用自然语言询问实时天气和天气预报，即可立即获得结构化数据，无需手动调用 API。

适用于能源交易员、物流公司、可再生能源运营商、保险团队和航空规划人员，帮助他们构建以天气信息为基础的 AI 工作流。

payload.description: 原生 AI 物联网基础设施
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Interact with your Connhex industrial IoT devices directly from ChatGPT. Inspect telemetry and device connectivity, create and manage rules, and stay up to date with your devices by checking fleet status, reviewing uptime, and investigating issues as they happen.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中与 Connhex 工业物联网设备交互。检查遥测和设备连接，创建和管理规则，并通过检查设备群状态、查看正常运行时间和调查实时问题，持续了解设备情况。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: O DATAHILL conecta agentes de IA à camada de inteligência de gestão da sua empresa, reduzindo a distância entre informação e decisão. Opera sobre os sistemas existentes, organiza o contexto do negócio, explica variações, prioriza o que merece atenção e orienta as próximas ações. Na conversa, o gestor explora indicadores, entende o resultado e decide com base em contexto organizacional — sem a recomendação substituir o seu julgamento.
payload.longDescription: DATAHILL 将 AI 智能体连接到企业的管理智能层，缩短信息与决策之间的距离。它基于现有系统运行，整理业务上下文、解释变化、确定值得关注事项的优先级，并指引后续行动。在对话中，管理者可以探索指标、理解结果，并基于组织背景作出决策——建议不会取代管理者自己的判断。

payload.name: Lusca
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lusca helps Shopify merchants connect their store and marketing accounts to ChatGPT. It reviews catalog health, Google Ads performance, Merchant Center feed status, and Search Console demand signals, then prepares safe recommendations and daily reports. Any action that could change a store or campaign is shown in an approval screen and requires explicit human approval before execution.
payload.longDescription: Lusca 帮助 Shopify 商家将商店和营销账户连接到 ChatGPT。它会检查目录健康状况、Google Ads 表现、Merchant Center feed 状态和 Search Console 需求信号，然后准备安全建议和每日报告。任何可能改变商店或营销活动的操作都会在审批页面显示，并且必须获得人工明确批准后才能执行。

payload.name: DriveTime Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DriveTime Careers brings DriveTime job discovery into ChatGPT, helping you explore open roles across the company in a faster, more conversational way.

Search opportunities by keyword, team, job function, location, experience level, or workplace preferences, then review important details like responsibilities, qualifications, compensation, benefits, and scheduling information when available.

From automotive operations and customer experience roles to technology, analytics, finance, logistics, and corporate opportunities, the app helps you quickly narrow the search and better understand which roles may fit your background and career goals.

Once you find a role you want to explore further, you can open the official job posting and continue to the application process.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中探索 DriveTi

me
职位，可按关键词、团队、职能、地点、

经验和工作偏好搜索，并查看职责、资格、薪酬

、福利和排班信息，最后打开官方职位页面申请。

payload.name: QR Tracker
payload.description: 创建和跟踪 QR 码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your QRTracker account to access and manage your tracked QR codes directly from ChatGPT.

View your existing QR codes, destinations, scan counts, and recent scan analytics. Create new tracked QR codes and update the destination of an existing dynamic QR code without changing its short code or reprinting the QR code.

QRTracker only accesses QR codes belonging to the account you authorize. Available features and creation limits follow your QRTracker plan.
payload.longDescription:
连接 QRTracker 账户，即可直接在 ChatGPT 中访问和管理所跟踪的 QR 码。

查看现有 QR 码、目标地址、扫描次数和近期扫描分析数据。创建新的跟踪 QR 码，并更新现有动态 QR 码的目标地址，无需更改其短代码或重新打印 QR 码。

QRTracker 只会访问你授权账户中的 QR 码。可用功能和创建限额遵循你的 QRTracker 方案。

payload.name: Kangaroo Rewards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kangaroo Rewards lets merchants review their connected loyalty program, including business details, customer profiles, points and transaction history, campaigns, offers, redemption rewards, loyalty settings, and performance metrics. It provides plain-language context for campaign status, engagement rates, attributed revenue, and other aggregate reports.
payload.longDescription: Kangaroo Rewards 允许商家查看已连接的忠诚度计划，包括企业详情、客户档案、积分和交易历史、营销活动、优惠、兑换奖励、忠诚度设置及绩效指标。它会以通俗易懂的语言解释活动状态、互动率、归因收入及其他汇总报告。

payload.name: Counter
payload.description: 按你的价格估算工程费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Counter connects your builders’-merchant price book to ChatGPT so you can price up a job in seconds. Ask for any material and Counter returns your own agreed prices so your estimates are fast and accurate.
payload.longDescription: Counter 将你的建筑材料供应商价目表连接到 ChatGPT，让你在几秒内估算项目费用。询问任何材料，Counter 就会返回你自己的约定价格，让报价快速又准确。

payload.name: Respond.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Respond.io helps teams find and manage contacts, review and send customer messages, update conversation ownership and status, organize workspace data, and configure AI agents from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Respond.io 帮助团队通过 ChatGPT 查找和管理联系人、查看并发送客户消息、更新对话负责人和状态、整理工作区数据，以及配置 AI 智能体。

payload.name: Stabile: Loyalty Rewards Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stabile helps ChatGPT users check Shopify merchant loyalty terms, estimate points earned for a cart, look up reward options with shopper consent, and redeem eligible reward codes before checkout.

For configured merchant workflows, Stabile can also support reviewed win-back points rewards for selected customers.

Stabile does not search products, create carts, process payments, or place orders. Checkout remains with Shopify or the merchant.
payload.longDescription:
Stabile 帮助 ChatGPT 用户查看 Shopify 商家的会员忠诚计划条款、估算购物车可获得的积分、在购物者同意后查询奖励选项，并在结账前兑换符合条件的奖励码。

针对已配置的商家工作流，Stabile 还可以支持经审核后向指定客户发放召回积分奖励。

Stabile 不搜索商品、不创建购物车、不处理付款，也不下订单。结账仍由 Shopify 或商家负责。

payload.name: NexTrade360
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NexTrade360 helps authorized barter-exchange staff use ChatGPT to search member and prospect records, review operational and financial reports, analyze exchange activity, identify trade and credit-risk opportunities, and create internal notes and follow-up tasks in the exchange they select.
payload.longDescription: NexTrade360 帮助获授权的易货交易所员工使用 ChatGPT 搜索会员和潜在客户记录、查看运营和财务报告、分析交易活动、发现贸易和信用风险机会，并在所选交易所中创建内部笔记和后续跟进任务。

payload.name: El Tasador - Soluna
payload.description: 为 Amazon US 估算费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Appraiser para Amazon US: evalúa gating por ASIN, consulta precios y fees, guarda costos y notas, y cotiza con la cuenta de Ingram Micro del usuario. Cada usuario conecta su propia cuenta de Amazon Seller.
payload.longDescription: Amazon US 估价工具：按 ASIN 评估门槛限制，查询价格和费用，保存成本与备注，并使用用户的 Ingram Micro 账户报价。每位用户都需连接自己的 Amazon Seller 账户。

payload.name: SearchFit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SearchFit tracks how a brand appears in AI assistant answers and helps close the gaps. See whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI mention your brand for the questions buyers actually ask, and how you compare with competitors. From there, generate and publish articles to a connected CMS, research keywords, audit a site for technical problems, and report on Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 alongside AI visibility. Requires a SearchFit account with at least one brand.
payload.longDescription: SearchFit 追踪品牌在 AI 助手回答中的呈现方式，并帮助弥补差距。查看 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和 Google 是否会在买家实际提出的问题中提及你的品牌，以及你与竞争对手相比的表现。接下来，可向已连接的 CMS 生成并发布文章、研究关键词、审计网站技术问题，并结合 AI 可见度报告 Google Search Console 和 Google Analytics 4 数据。需要拥有至少一个品牌的 SearchFit 账户。

payload.name: Voluum
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Voluum helps users inspect advertising performance, manage campaigns and tracking assets, export reports, and operate integrations and automation rules through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Voluum 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看广告表现、管理营销活动和追踪资产、导出报告，以及操作集成和自动化规则。

payload.name: magicplan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
magicplan is a field app for measuring, documenting, and estimating on site, widely used in property restoration, insurance, and construction. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to a magicplan workspace, so you can review and reason over project data directly in the conversation.

Once connected, ChatGPT can:
- List and open projects, and read the field data captured on each floor plan
- Retrieve measured areas and volumes, broken down by floor and room
- Read the custom forms filled out on site, and the drying history recorded by moisture instruments
- Browse project photos and files, matched to the part of the building they document
- Open estimates down to individual line items and cost totals

A connection is authenticated at the workspace level with your magicplan Customer ID and API key, and acts on behalf of that whole workspace. The connector is read-only: it never creates, changes, or deletes anything in magicplan, and your API key is never shared with ChatGPT.

Typical uses: preparing a scope of work from a restoration project, checking which rooms still need documentation, summarizing an estimate, or answering questions about a plan's measurements.
payload.longDescription:
magicplan 是一款现场测量、记录和估算应用，广泛用于财产修复、保险和建筑行业。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供对 magicplan 工作区的只读访问权限，让你可以直接在对话中查看和分析项目数据。

连接后，ChatGPT 可以：
- 列出并打开项目，读取每张平面图上记录的现场数据
- 获取按楼层和房间细分的测量面积与体积
- 读取现场填写的自定义表单，以及湿度仪器记录的干燥历史
- 浏览项目照片和文件，并关联到其记录的建筑部位
- 打开估算单并查看各个明细项目和费用总额

连接通过工作区级别的 magicplan 客户 ID 和 API 密钥进行身份验证，并代表整个工作区执行操作。连接器为只读：不会在 magicplan 中创建、更改或删除任何内容，API 密钥也不会分享给 ChatGPT。

常见用途：根据修复项目准备工作范围、检查哪些房间仍需记录、汇总估算单，或回答有关平面图测量数据的问题。

payload.name: Caretta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Caretta helps users inspect their sales calls, search call transcripts and summaries, review follow-up todos, and create or update private todos from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Caretta 帮助用户查看销售通话、搜索通话转录文本和摘要、检查后续待办事项，并直接在 ChatGPT 中创建或更新私密待办事项。

payload.name: magnews
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use magnews in ChatGPT to analyze email campaigns, newsletters, marketing automations, workflows, audiences, and databases. Review performance, opens, clicks, conversions, engagement, content, and trends available in your magnews account, with plain-language explanations and practical recommendations to turn marketing data into action.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 magnews 分析邮件营销活动、新闻简报、营销自动化、工作流、受众和数据库。查看 magnews 账户中可用的表现、打开率、点击、转化、互动、内容和趋势，并获得通俗易懂的解释和可执行建议，将营销数据转化为行动。

payload.name: Energy Aspects
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Energy Aspects gives AI agents direct access to expert energy market intelligence — research reports, real-time analyst commentary, and timeseries data across oil, gas, power, and related markets.

Energy Aspects is an independent research firm trusted by traders, investors, and energy professionals worldwide. The connector draws on three content types: in-depth research publications with analysis and forecasts; EA Live posts with intraday market commentary from analysts; and a library of quantitative timeseries covering supply, demand, inventories, flows, and prices — including point-in-time queries against historical releases.
payload.longDescription:
Energy Aspects 为 AI 代理提供石油、天然气、电力等能源市场研

究、实时评论和时间序列数据，涵盖供需、库存、流量和价格，并支持查询历史发布时点。

payload.name: Introw PRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Introw is a partner relationship platform (PRM) that allows you to launch a personalised partner portal in minutes - all integrated with your CRM (HubSpot & Salesforce).
If you're working with resellers, referral partners, distributors, implementation partners,... keep reading.

Introw creates personalised partner experiences, enhancing partner engagement and efficiency without the lengthy implementations of a traditional PRM. Introw keeps your HubSpot CRM data as the single source of truth.

Think about deal registration, training partners with a built in LMS, enabling them with content, tracking partner goals, and more.
payload.longDescription:
Introw 是一款合作伙伴关系管理平台（PRM），可在几分钟内启动个性化合作伙伴门户，并与 CRM（HubSpot 和 Salesforce）集成。
如果你与经销商、推荐合作伙伴、分销商、实施合作伙伴等合作，请继续了解。

Introw 无需传统 PRM 那样漫长的实施周期，即可打造个性化合作伙伴体验，提升合作伙伴参与度和效率。Introw 将 HubSpot CRM 数据作为唯一可信数据源。

功能包括交易注册、通过内置 LMS 为合作伙伴提供培训、向他们提供内容、跟踪合作伙伴目标等。

payload.name: Aira
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aira lets business owners review recent AI receptionist calls from ChatGPT. Ask for today's calls, recent calls, or the latest call, then open summaries, collected lead details, transcript snippets, and recordings in an interactive call review panel.
payload.longDescription: Aira让企业主通过ChatGPT查看AI接待员的近期通话。询问今天的通话、近期通话或最新一次通话，然后在交互式通话查看面板中打开摘要、收集到的潜在客户详情、转写片段和录音。

payload.name: GLG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GLG gives you instant access to the world's largest expert network. Search thousands of expert transcripts, explore insights across industries, and review content from your own research calls — all without leaving your workflow. Every response is grounded in named, verified experts from moderated GLG-hosted conversations, giving you the primary intelligence you need to make faster, more confident decisions.
payload.longDescription: GLG 让你即时访问全球最大的专家网络。搜索数千份专家访谈文字记录，探索各行业洞见，并查看你自己的研究访谈内容，无需离开当前工作流程。每条回复都基于经过核验的具名专家在 GLG 主持的对话中提供的内容，为你快速做出更有把握的决策提供一手信息。

payload.name: SyncMe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SyncMe is a multi-channel eCommerce sync platform that connects your inventory, orders, and product listings across Amazon, Shopify, Meta, Salla, Noon, eBay, Zid and more, all in real time. Eliminate overselling, reduce manual work, and scale your online business effortlessly.
payload.longDescription: SyncMe 是一个多渠道电商同步平台，可实时连接 Amazon、Shopify、Meta、Salla、Noon、eBay、Zid 等平台上的库存、订单和商品刊登信息。避免超卖、减少手动工作，让你的线上业务轻松扩展。

payload.name: IncorpFlow Copilot
payload.description: 新加坡 CSP 运营助手
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IncorpFlow Copilot is for authenticated CSP tenant admins. It answers product-use questions, reads only the linked tenant workspace, and can create confirmed tenant records such as backend service requests, after-payment incorporation tickets, and Quotech support tickets. It may also send confirmed emails such as selected company-file delivery, SOA reminders, and export OTPs. Copilot does not collect restricted personal documents, full personal identifiers, payment card details, health data, biometric data, SSNs, or PCI data inside ChatGPT. Required onboarding details and supporting documents are submitted through secure IncorpFlow pages under tenant-admin authority and the Quotech privacy policy.
payload.longDescription: IncorpFlow Copilot 面向已认证的 CSP 租户管理员。它回答产品使用问题，只读取关联租户工作区，并可创建已确认的租户记录，例如后端服务请求、付款后注册工单和 Quotech 支持工单；也可发送已确认的公司文件交付、SOA 提醒和导出 OTP 邮件。它不会在 ChatGPT 内收集受限个人文件、完整个人标识、银行卡、健康、生物识别、SSN 或 PCI 数据。必要入驻信息和证明文件须在租户管理员权限下通过安全 IncorpFlow 页面提交，并遵循 Quotech 隐私政策。

payload.name: Intelligo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Intelligo brings risk intelligence into ChatGPT. Connect your Intelligo account to pull background checks, credit checks, and adverse-media and social-media screening into the conversation. Summarize a subject's findings and risk flags, compare reports to see what changed, search across your profiles for a name or keyword, and prepare due-diligence write-ups — grounded in your own Intelligo data. Sign-in is secured with OAuth, and ChatGPT only accesses data your account is permitted to see. Requires an Intelligo account.
payload.longDescription: Intelligo 将风险情报带入 ChatGPT。关联 Intelligo 账户后，可在对话中调取背景调查、信用调查以及负面媒体和社交媒体筛查结果。总结调查对象的发现和风险标记、比较报告以查看变化、按姓名或关键词搜索个人资料，并根据你自己的 Intelligo 数据撰写尽职调查材料。登录通过 OAuth 安全保护，ChatGPT 只能访问账户获准查看的数据。需要 Intelligo 账户。

payload.name: Calendesk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Calendesk connects your booking management platform directly to ChatGPT. Use natural language to manage your business:

  • List, create, update, and cancel bookings
  • Search and manage customers
  • Check available time slots and services
  • View business statistics — revenue, booking trends, employee performance
  • Get real-time dashboard insights and forecasts

Works with your existing Calendesk account. Authenticate once and manage your entire scheduling business through conversation.
payload.longDescription:
Calendesk 将您的预订管理平台直接连接到 ChatGPT。使用自然语言管理业务：

• 列出、创建、更新和取消预订
  • 搜索和管理客户
  • 查看可用时间段和服务
  • 查看业务统计——收入、预订趋势、员工表现
  • 获取实时仪表板洞察和预测

可与现有 Calendesk 账户配合使用。只需认证一次，即可通过对话管理完整的日程安排业务。

payload.name: JUNE
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This JUNE agent helps law firms and legal departments find cases, documents, deadlines, appointments, tasks, contacts, case facts, and document facts; create and update private case records; and prepare outgoing correspondence through ChatGPT. Access follows each user's existing JUNE permissions and tenant boundaries. Please note: You cannot use this plugin unless you have an active JUNE account on a JUNE tenant provisioned for your organisation.
payload.longDescription: JUNE 智能体可帮助律所和法务部门查找案件、文档、截止日期、约会、任务、联系人、案件事实和文档事实；创建和更新私密案件记录；并通过 ChatGPT 准备对外函件。访问权限遵循每位用户现有的 JUNE 权限和租户隔离规则。请注意：你必须拥有有效的 JUNE 账户，并且该账户位于为你所在机构配置的 JUNE 租户中，才能使用此插件。

payload.name: BencinaMCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BencinaMCP lets users ask natural-language questions about fuel prices in Chile using official CNE data refreshed every morning. Compare Gasolina 93, 95, 97 and Diesel by comuna, region, or brand; find where prices are lowest or highest; and see how concentrated each local market is, including which brand dominates and by how much. The dataset covers about 1,800 stations across 315 comunas and supports questions like "precio de la 95 en Antofagasta", "comunas donde una sola marca controla el mercado", or "compara el diesel entre regiones".
payload.longDescription: BencinaMCP 让用户使用每天早晨更新的 CNE 官方数据，以自然语言询问智利燃油价格。按市镇、地区或品牌比较 Gasolina 93、95、97 和 Diesel；寻找价格最低或最高的地方；了解各地市场的集中程度，包括哪个品牌占主导、占据多少份额。数据集覆盖 315 个市镇的约 1,800 个加油站，支持“Antofagasta 的 95 号汽油价格”、“只有一个品牌控制市场的市镇”或“比较各地区的柴油价格”等问题。

payload.name: Nexvio AI
payload.description: 你的 AI 支持代理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to your Nexvio workspace to manage AI agents, contacts, support tickets, analytics, and help documentation through our MCP App.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Nexvio 工作区，通过我们的 MCP App 管理 AI 代理、联系人、支持工单、分析数据和帮助文档。

payload.name: Instagram & TikTok by 1Social
payload.description: 发布到 Facebook、LinkedIn 和 X
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Schedule and post to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Threads and Bluesky from a single message. 1Social fits each caption to the network's limit, warns when a network needs an image, and schedules posts up to 30 days ahead.

After publishing it reports each network separately — what landed, what failed and why — and can retry one network without touching the rest. Edit or cancel anything still scheduled.
payload.longDescription:
通过一条消息，即可安排并发布内容到 Instagram、TikTok、Facebook、LinkedIn、X（Twitter）、Threads 和 Bluesky。1Social 会根据各平台的字数限制调整每条文案，在平台需要图片时提醒你，并可将帖子安排在未来 30 天内发布。

发布后，它会分别报告各个平台的结果——哪些成功发布、哪些失败及原因——还可以仅重试某个平台，不影响其他平台。你也可以编辑或取消仍在计划中的内容。

payload.name: Cryotos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MCP for the Maintenance team to connect to the Cryotos CMMS application and fetch key details for evaluation.
payload.longDescription: 供维护团队使用的 MCP，可连接 Cryotos CMMS 应用并获取关键详情以供评估。

payload.name: ClearPolicy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ClearPolicy helps organizations create and publish policy documents, manage people and groups, send electronic signature or acknowledgment requests, issue reminders, and track document compliance from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: ClearPolicy 帮助组织通过 ChatGPT 创建和发布政策文件、管理人员和群组、发送电子签名或确认请求、发出提醒，并跟踪文件合规情况。

payload.name: Asva AI
payload.description: 查看品牌在 AI 搜索中的表现
payload.summaryOriginal: See your brand on AI search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Asva AI is an Answer Engine Optimization platform. This app lets you read your brand's AI search visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, Meta AI, and Google AI Mode, and generate on brand content from your own brand kit. Ask how often your brand is mentioned, what share of voice you hold, which domains cite you most, and how sentiment is trending. Generate content briefs, full blog, landing, social, or email pieces, llms.txt files, and on demand visibility audits. Every response is scoped to your signed in Asva AI workspace.
payload.longDescription: Asva AI 是答案引擎优化平台。本应用让你查看品牌在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Copilot、Grok、Meta AI 和 Google AI Mode 中的 AI 搜索曝光度，并根据自己的品牌资料包生成符合品牌风格的内容。你可以询问品牌被提及的频率、声量份额、引用最多的域名，以及情感倾向的变化趋势。生成内容简报、完整博客文章、落地页、社交内容或邮件、llms.txt 文件，以及按需曝光度审查。每次响应的范围都限于你已登录的 Asva AI 工作区。

payload.name: Taverity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Taverity lets users work with an assistant to find contact lists, preview personal follow-up texts, and queue approved one-time messages in their Taverity account. Queued messages surface in the Taverity iPhone app and are sent from the user's own iPhone number after approval; the MCP server does not send SMS directly.
payload.longDescription: Taverity 让用户可以借助助手查找联系人列表、预览个人后续短信，并在自己的 Taverity 账户中排队发送经批准的一次性消息。排队的消息会显示在 Taverity iPhone 应用中，并在获得批准后通过用户自己的 iPhone 号码发送；MCP 服务器不会直接发送 SMS。

payload.name: EventHex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EventHex helps event organizers list and configure franchise events, manage tickets and agendas, review registrations and analytics, and build and publish event websites through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: EventHex 帮助活动组织者通过 ChatGPT 发布和配置连锁品牌活动、管理门票与日程、查看报名和分析数据，以及创建并发布活动网站。

payload.name: Faraday
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect an AI agent to your Faraday account to ingest customer-supplied person-level data, use Faraday's consumer data, resolve identities, build audiences and models, and deliver person-level fields and predictions to your destinations.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 代理连接到你的 Faraday 账户，以接收客户提供的个人级数据、使用 Faraday 的消费者数据、解析身份、构建受众和模型，并向目标系统传送个人级字段和预测结果。

payload.name: Profit.co
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Profit.co is an AI-powered strategy execution platform that bridges the gap between high-level strategy and daily execution. Founded in Silicon Valley and headquartered in Texas, the company serves customers across 70 countries, ranging from agile startups to more than 50 Fortune 500 giants. 

The platform is architected around three critical organizational pillars to drive measurable results:

      • Plan: Defines strategy through advanced OKR Software, Balanced Scorecards, Hoshin Kanri and Strategy Roadmaps to ensure total organizational alignment.
      • Process: Drives execution via Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Task Management, Timesheets, and structured Meeting tools.
      • People: Aligning the human side of performance through Employee Engagement, Recognition, Pulse Surveys, 360-degree Feedback, and continuous Performance Management.

Profit.co is designed for enterprise-scale adoption, featuring 80+ seamless integrations with essential tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, and Salesforce. Consistently recognized for enterprise-grade excellence, Profit.co is featured in Gartner® Hype Cycle™ reports, the Capterra Shortlist, and maintains its position as a G2 Leader. Supported by a global team and a robust network of local partners, Profit.co complements its technology with expert coaching, strategic consulting, and 24/7 live support to ensure every organization achieves its most ambitious strategic goals.
payload.longDescription:
Profit.co 是一个由 AI 驱动的战略执行平台，旨在衔接高层战略与日常执行。公司创立于硅谷，总部位于德克萨斯州，服务遍及 70 个国家/地区的客户，从灵活敏捷的初创企业到 50 多家《财富》500 强巨头。

该平台围绕三个关键组织支柱构建，以推动可衡量的成果：

• 规划：通过先进的 OKR 软件、平衡计分卡、方针管理（Hoshin Kanri）和战略路线图制定战略，确保整个组织目标一致。
      • 流程：通过项目组合管理（PPM）、任务管理、工时表和结构化会议工具推动执行。
      • 人员：通过员工敬业度、认可、脉搏调查、360 度反馈和持续绩效管理，协调绩效管理中的人员因素。

Profit.co 面向企业规模化采用而设计，提供 80+ 项与 Slack、Microsoft Teams、Jira 和 Salesforce 等关键工具的无缝集成。Profit.co 持续因企业级卓越表现获得认可，入选 Gartner® Hype Cycle™ 报告和 Capterra Shortlist，并保持 G2 领导者地位。凭借全球团队和强大的本地合作伙伴网络，Profit.co 还提供专家辅导、战略咨询和 24/7 实时支持，以确保每个组织都能实现最具雄心的战略目标。

payload.name: BidPrime
payload.description: 访问 BidPrime 商机线索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your BidPrime leads inboxes including bids, meeting keyword alerts and emerging opportunities  - including matching document content for summarizing and evaluating new bids and opportunities.
payload.longDescription: 访问 BidPrime 线索收件箱，包括招标、会议关键词提醒和新兴机会，以及匹配的文档内容，用于总结和评估新招标与机会。

payload.name: Sunwise
payload.description: 太阳能安装商业务应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sunwise is an all-in-one platform designed for solar installers to manage and grow their business more efficiently. The app helps you organize projects, track leads, create proposals, and coordinate your team from a single, easy-to-use workspace. By centralizing daily operations, Sunwise saves time, reduces manual work, and gives installers better visibility into their sales pipeline and ongoing installations—so you can focus on delivering great solar projects to your customers.
payload.longDescription: Sunwise 是面向太阳能安装商的一体化平台，旨在帮助他们更高效地管理和拓展业务。此应用帮助你在一个简单易用的工作区中整理项目、跟踪潜在客户、制作提案并协调团队。通过集中管理日常运营，Sunwise 节省时间、减少手动工作，并让安装商更清楚地了解销售管道和正在进行的安装项目，从而专注于为客户交付出色的太阳能项目。

payload.name: Recooty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recooty is an AI-powered hiring platform to create job descriptions, post to job boards, and manage applicants.
payload.longDescription: Recooty 是一个 AI 招聘平台，可用于创建职位描述、发布到招聘网站并管理申请者。

payload.name: Events Match
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Events Match helps founders, creators, marketers, investors, and growth professionals find events suited to their goals.
Tell it your role, industry, location, stage, budget and desired outcome to receive curated event recommendations, clear reasons for each match, official event links and a practical preparation plan.
payload.longDescription: Events Match 根据你的角色、行业、地点、阶段、预算和目标，为创始人、创作者、营销人员、投资人等推荐活动，提供匹配理由、官方链接和准备计划。

payload.name: Lumini
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI assistant to Lumini — AI-powered New Zealand government intelligence. Search legislation, track bills, monitor consultations, and get insights about parliamentary activity, all scoped to your organisation.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 助手连接到 Lumini——由 AI 驱动的新西兰政府情报服务。搜索法规、追踪法案、监测公众咨询并获取议会活动见解，所有内容均限定在你的组织范围内。

payload.name: MimikFlow
payload.description: 启动 B2B 客户开发
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MimikFlow helps existing customers launch and manage automated B2B prospecting from their AI assistant. They can review results and conversations, handle drafts and escalations, adjust campaign settings, and add selected prospects while MimikFlow preserves the account's plan, permissions, and outreach safety limits.
payload.longDescription: MimikFlow 帮助现有客户通过 AI 助手启动和管理自动化 B2B 客户开发。他们可以查看结果和对话、处理草稿与升级事项、调整活动设置，并添加选定的潜在客户；MimikFlow 会遵守账户套餐、权限和外联安全限额。

payload.name: Candidate Time Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Candidate Time Extractor turns candidate availability messages into structured interview time details. It extracts available times, timezone, contact details, notes, missing fields, source text, and errors, helping recruiting workflows organize candidate replies faster.

The app is read-only and stateless. It does not schedule interviews, send invitations, contact candidates, update ATS systems, rank candidates, or make hiring decisions.
payload.longDescription:
Candidate Time Extractor 将候选人的可用时间消息转换为结构化的面试时间信息。它会提取可用时段、时区、联系信息、备注、缺失字段、源文本和错误，帮助招聘流程更快地整理候选人的回复。

此应用为只读且无状态。它不会安排面试、发送邀请、联系候选人、更新 ATS 系统、给候选人排名或做出招聘决定。

payload.name: First FMCG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: First FMCG is a B2B wholesale marketplace for fast-moving consumer goods (food, drinks, snacks, household, personal care and more). Buyers can search live stock offers across suppliers, compare normalized per-piece prices, view offer details, and send purchase requests — supplier identities stay anonymous until they accept. Suppliers can publish and manage their own offers directly from chat, including from a pasted price list. 0% commission, direct supplier contact.
payload.longDescription: First FMCG 是快速消费品 B2B 批发市场，买家可搜索供应商库存、比较单件价格、查看报价并发起采购请求；供应商可从聊天发布和管理报价。供应商接受前保持匿名，佣金为 0%。

payload.name: AuntBird Practice Management
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your AuntBird practice management account to securely access the business information you are authorized to view, including clients, engagements, time, billing, invoices, payments, expenses, and practice reporting. Access is controlled by your AuntBird account, firm, role, and permissions.
payload.longDescription: 将ChatGPT连接到你的AuntBird业务管理账户，安全访问你获授权查看的业务信息，包括客户、业务项目、工时、计费、发票、付款、费用和业务报告。访问由你的AuntBird账户、公司、角色和权限控制。

payload.name: Resimplifi Agent
payload.description: 搜索并分析商业地产房源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Resimplifi CRE Data Search and analyze verified, accurate, and real-time commercial real estate listings directly within Claude. Resimplifi is natively integrated as an MCP server, bringing live CRE data into your AI workflow without switching platforms. Analyze communities, explore market availability, and move deals forward - all from one place. Built for professionals who need a faster, more sustainable workflow.
payload.longDescription:
该插件搜索并分析商业地产房源。以下功能和限制适用：
Resimplifi CRE Data Search and analyze verified, accurate, and real-time commercial real estate listings directly within Claude. Resimplifi is natively integrated as an MCP server, bringing live CRE data into your AI workflow without switching platforms. Analyze communities, explore market availability, and move deals forward - all from one place. Built for professionals who need a faster, more sustainable workflow.

payload.name: Simmie
payload.description: 构建 AI 销售模拟训练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Simmie turns what ChatGPT already knows about your business, plus any
materials you provide, into sales training your team can actually practise.

Describe the conversation you want reps to get better at and Simmie builds
the whole thing: the scenario, an AI buyer persona, a training module, and
the scoring rubric, saved to your account with a practice link you can share.

It also grades real calls. Paste a speaker-identified transcript and Simmie
scores it against your organization's rubric, saves the result to that rep's
record, and can build follow-up practice targeting exactly what went wrong,
then assign it to them.

Set your scoring standard once, in plain English, and every call after that
is measured the same way.

Requires a Simmie account. Monthly and annual plans are available.
payload.longDescription:
Simmie 会结合 ChatGPT 对你业务已有的了解和你提供的材料，转化为团队可以实际练习的销售培训内容。

描述你希望销售代表提升能力的对话场景，Simmie 就会构建完整内容：情境、AI 买家角色、培训模块和评分标准，并将其保存到你的账户，同时生成可分享的练习链接。

它还可以评估真实通话。粘贴已标明发言者的文字记录，Simmie 会根据你组织的评分标准进行评分，将结果保存到该销售代表的档案中，并可针对出现的问题生成后续练习，再分配给对方。

只需用通俗语言设置一次评分标准，此后每次通话都会按照相同方式评估。

需要 Simmie 账户。提供月度和年度套餐。

payload.name: Gleap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Gleap brings your customer support workspace into ChatGPT. Search and triage tickets, look up contacts and companies, reply to customers or add an internal note, keep your help center up to date, and check support metrics without leaving the conversation.

Ask for the open high-priority tickets that are still unassigned, pull a customer's full history before you answer them, draft a help center article in every language you support, or compare this month's first response time to last month's. Sales teams can move deals through CRM pipelines, and product teams can search feature requests and survey responses.

Connecting takes a single sign-in: authorize with your Gleap account, choose the project ChatGPT may access, and you are set. Every action runs with your own Gleap permissions.
payload.longDescription:
Gleap 将客户支持工作区带入 ChatGPT。无需离开对话，即可搜索和分流工单、查询联系人和公司、回复客户或添加内部备注、更新帮助中心并查看支持指标。

你可以查询仍未分配的高优先级待处理工单，在回复客户前调取其完整历史记录，用所有支持语言起草帮助中心文章，或比较本月和上月的首次响应时间。销售团队可以在 CRM 销售管道中推进交易，产品团队可以搜索功能请求和调查回复。

连接只需登录一次：使用 Gleap 账户授权，选择 ChatGPT 可以访问的项目，即可开始。每项操作都使用你自己的 Gleap 权限执行。

payload.name: Govly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Govly helps users find and analyze government contracting opportunities, awards, contacts, procurement signals, places, and contract pricing; manage saved searches and inbox matches; and collaborate in workspaces through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Govly 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查找和分析政府合同机会、中标结果、联系人、采购信号、地点和合同价格；管理已保存的搜索和收件箱匹配项；并在工作区中协作。

payload.name: DigiTrust Evidence Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Review selected non-sensitive claims and source excerpts for security and procurement work. DigiTrust Evidence Assistant maps claims to supplied evidence, flags missing source details, checks exact quotations and supplied dates, and produces focused reviewer questions. Results help you organize a review; they do not verify factual truth, source authenticity, compliance or permission to share. Synthetic examples are also available. The Assistant does not access private workspaces, fetch source links, retain submitted review content in application storage, or approve external use. Share only material you have explicitly confirmed is non-sensitive and permitted to send to DigiTrans.
payload.longDescription:
针对安全和采购工作，审查选定的非敏感声明及来源摘录。
DigiTrust Evidence Assistant 将声明与提供的证据对应，标记缺失的来源细节，核查精确引用内容及提供日期，并生成针对性的审查问题。
结果有助于您组织审查工作；但不验证事实真实性、来源真实性、合规性或共享权限。
也可提供合成示例。
该助手不会访问私人工作区、获取来源链接、在应用存储中保留提交的审查内容或批准外部使用。
仅可共享您明确确认为非敏感且允许发送至 DigiTrans 的材料。

payload.name: Syntheia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Syntheia brings two things lawyers do every day into ChatGPT.

Compare: upload a counterparty's draft and your last version, and Syntheia returns a clause-by-clause list of insertions, deletions, and moved text, with a redlined document to download.

Query: ask a question about one agreement, a group of agreements, or your whole workspace. Syntheia navigates each document's structure, follows cross-references, and returns the exact provision text with a link to the source clause, so every answer is grounded in the document rather than in a summary.

Documents stay in your private Syntheia workspace, and results are scoped to your account.
payload.longDescription:
Syntheia 将律师每天都会做的两项工作带入 ChatGPT。

比较：上传对方的草稿和你方上一版，Syntheia 会逐条列出新增、删除和移动的文本，并提供可下载的红线修订文档。

查询：针对一份协议、多份协议或整个工作区提问。Syntheia 会分析每份文档的结构、追踪交叉引用，并返回准确的条款原文及其来源条款链接，因此每个回答都有文档依据，而非仅依赖摘要。

文档保存在你私有的 Syntheia 工作区中，结果仅限于你的账户范围。

payload.name: Breakcold
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Breakcold helps users find and update CRM records, manage tasks and notes, review inbox conversations and meetings, send messages, and configure authorized workflow integrations through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Breakcold 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中查找和更新 CRM 记录、管理任务和备注、查看收件箱对话及会议、发送消息，并配置获授权的工作流集成。

payload.name: Icebreaker
payload.description: 搜索你的各类人脉网络
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whether you're hiring, selling, or searching, everyone knows that the best opportunities come from leveraging your existing network.

With Icebreaker, you can finally search across your own extended network, directly from your favorite AI tools. Turn cold leads into warm referrals and amplify your conversion rates by 5-20x when you make your agents network-aware, across LinkedIn, X, GitHub, and more.
payload.longDescription:
无论你是在招聘、销售还是寻找机会，大家都知道最好的机会往往来自现有人脉。

通过 Icebreaker，你终于可以直接在常用的 AI 工具中搜索自己的扩展人脉网络。让智能体了解你的人脉关系，覆盖 LinkedIn、X、GitHub 等平台，将陌生潜在客户转化为熟人推荐，并将转化率提升 5-20 倍。

payload.name: Worke
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Worke helps authenticated users find and inspect contacts, inquiries, contracts, assets and loans, calendar events, attendance status and purchase-pairing data from their company workspace, and answers analysis questions in one call: how a contract is doing (agreed price, invoiced, costs by kind, margin), what the company has with a customer, how a salesperson performs over a period, and how the inquiry funnel converts. Every tool is read-only and results are limited by each user's existing Worke permissions.
payload.longDescription: Worke 帮助通过身份验证的用户查找和查看公司工作区中的联系人、咨询、合同、资产和贷款、日历事件、考勤状态及采购配对数据，并可一次性回答分析问题：合同进展如何（约定价格、已开票金额、各类成本、利润率）、公司与某客户有哪些业务往来、某销售人员在一段时间内的表现如何，以及咨询漏斗的转化情况。所有工具均为只读，结果受每位用户现有 Worke 权限限制。

payload.name: Audiense Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Audiense Insights is an audience segmentation platform that looks beyond demographics to help you personalize at scale. Use it to tell stories that resonate, make data-driven creative decisions, identify insights about customers, discover influencer or partners, and more. ‍ 
 
Gain the ability to understand segments of consumers worth targeting and unlock cultural insights that can improve connection, conversions, and customer experience.  

This MCP connector is a product line extension that enables the creation and analysis of audience intelligence reports directly within ChatGPT, resulting in new ways to interpret and visualize the insights.
payload.longDescription:
Audiense Insights 是一个受众细分平台，超越人口统计信息，帮助你大规模实现个性化。用它讲述能引起共鸣的故事、做出数据驱动的创意决策、发现客户洞察、寻找有影响力的人或合作伙伴，以及更多用途。

获得理解值得定位的消费者群体的能力，并发掘文化洞察，改善联系、转化和客户体验。

这个 MCP 连接器是产品线的扩展，支持直接在 ChatGPT 内创建和分析受众情报报告，带来解读和可视化洞察的新方式。

payload.name: Baukosten-Cockpit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Baukosten-Cockpit helps homeowners and project stakeholders view and manage construction projects, cost forecasts, estimates, offers, payments, and related documents directly in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Baukosten-Cockpit帮助房主和项目相关方直接在ChatGPT中查看和管理建筑项目、成本预测、估算、报价、付款及相关文档。

payload.name: 20Tabs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Running a hospitality business means your answers are spread across reports, dashboards, and closing sheets. With the 20Tabs connector, you can just ask ChatGPT instead.

Ask "What were my top sellers last week?", "How did April compare to March?", or "Show me all voided receipts from yesterday." You get a direct answer from your live 20Tabs data. No clicking through menus, no exporting spreadsheets.

The connector covers the full breadth of your 20Tabs account: sales and revenue reports, taxbreakdowns, daily and monthly closings, customer purchase history, receipt and payment details, and product performance. You can also manage your catalog, floor plan, and POS configuration through the same conversation.

Access is authorized through your 20Tabs account using OAuth. You control exactly which permissions ChatGPT receives.
payload.longDescription:
经营餐饮住宿业务意味着所需答案散布在报告、控制面板和结账表中。使用 20Tabs 连接器，你可以直接向 ChatGPT 提问。

询问“上周最畅销的产品是什么？”、“4 月和 3 月相比如何？”或“显示昨天所有作废收据”。你会从实时 20Tabs 数据中获得直接答案，无需逐层点击菜单，也无需导出电子表格。

连接器覆盖 20Tabs 账号的全部范围：销售和收入报告、税费明细、每日及每月结账、客户购买历史、收据和付款详情，以及产品表现。你还可以在同一段对话中管理商品目录、平面布局和 POS 配置。

通过你的 20Tabs 账号使用 OAuth 授权访问。你可以精确控制 ChatGPT 获得哪些权限。

payload.name: FileAssist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use this tool to work with documents stored in FileAssist using simple, natural language prompts. It allows users to quickly find relevant files, generate summaries, identify differences between documents, and extract key information without opening each file individually. This tool is best suited for efficiently reviewing, analyzing, and gaining insights from stored content within the FileAssist platform.
payload.longDescription: 通过简单的自然语言提示，使用此工具处理存储在 FileAssist 中的文档。它可以快速查找相关文件、生成摘要、找出文档差异并提取关键信息，无需逐一打开文件。此工具特别适合高效审阅、分析和洞察 FileAssist 平台中的存储内容。

payload.name: Testlify

payload.name: Workleap AI
payload.description: 了解团队健康度与产出
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask plain-language questions about your team and organization—answered with data from your Workleap account.

Instead of navigating dashboards, ask things like "What's our engagement score this month?", "Who is the new hire on my team?", or "Show me my recent recognition" and get a concise, visual answer.

What it covers:
- Engagement scores, eNPS, and participation trends—for your team or the whole org
- Employee profiles, hire dates, and reporting relationships
- Recognition cards you've sent and received
- Team structures and org context, so references like "my direct reports" resolve automatically

Built for managers and HR teams who want faster access to the signals already in Workleap, without switching tools.

payload.name: Qualisend
payload.description: 验证并清理电子邮件列表
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.
